cd /workspace/tmp/t && cat > t_final.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/t')
from harness import *

# cross-level pending drop when a drained packet terminates the connection
r = R([dg(1, [pk("H",0,[UNK]), pk("A",0,[PING])]), key(5,"H","install")], buffer_packets=4)
check('T1 cross-level pending drop', (r['packets'], r['conn']),
      ([(0,0,'error','FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',5,0),(0,1,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',5,None)],
       ('closed','FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR',5,(0,0,0),None,0)))
r = R([dg(1, [pk("H",0,[CL(False,2)]), pk("A",0,[PING])]), key(5,"H","install"), dg(7,[pk("I",0,[PING])])], buffer_packets=4)
check('T2 close in drain, pending+later', (r['packets'], r['conn']),
      ([(0,0,'accepted','OK',5,None),(0,1,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',5,None),(2,0,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',7,None)],
       ('closed','PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE',5,(0,0,0),2,5)))
r = R([dg(1, [pk("H",0,[PING]), pk("A",0,[PING])]), key(5,"A","discard")], buffer_packets=4)
check('T3 discard A keeps H pending', (r['packets'], r['keys']),
      ([(0,0,'buffered','NO_KEYS',1,None),(0,1,'dropped','KEYS_DISCARDED',5,None)],
       ('live','absent','absent','discarded')))
r = R([dg(1, [pk("H",0,[PING]), pk("A",0,[PING])]), key(5,"A","discard"), key(6,"H","install")], buffer_packets=4)
check('T4 discard A then install H', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'accepted','OK',6,None),(0,1,'dropped','KEYS_DISCARDED',5,None)])
# idle deadline uses last activity of a drained packet
r = R([dg(1, [pk("H",0,[PING])]), key(5,"H","install"), tick(20)], idle_ms=10, buffer_packets=4)
check('T5 activity from drained packet', r['conn'], ('idle','IDLE_TIMEOUT',15,(2,None,None),None,5))
# huge idle/time values
r = R([tick(1000000000000)], idle_ms=1000000000)
check('T6 huge idle', r['conn'], ('idle','IDLE_TIMEOUT',1000000000,(0,None,None),None,0))
r = R([dg(1000000000000, [pk("I",0,[PING])])])
check('T7 huge t accepted', r['conn'], ('open',None,None,None,None,1000000000000))
# max domains
r = R([KA, A(4611686018427387903, [CL(True, 4611686018427387903)])])
check('T8 max pn and code', (r['conn'], r['packets']),
      (('closed','PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE',1,(1,0,0),4611686018427387903,1), [(1,0,'accepted','OK',1,None)]))
r = R([dg(0, [pk("I",4611686018427387903,[ACK([[4611686018427387903,4611686018427387903]])])])],
      sent={"I":[[4611686018427387903,4611686018427387903]],"H":[],"A":[]})
check('T9 ack max range', r['packets'], [(0,0,'accepted','OK',0,None)])
# stream id at the very top
r = R([KA, A(0,[ST(4611686018427387900,0,"61")])])
check('T10 huge stream id limit', r['packets'], [(1,0,'error','STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR',1,0)])
r = R([KA, A(0,[ST(4611686018427387901,0,"61")])])
check('T10b odd stream id state', r['packets'], [(1,0,'error','STREAM_STATE_ERROR',1,0)])
# 0-size datagram with A only
r = R([KA, A(0,[PING],size=0)])
check('T11 A in 0 byte datagram', r['packets'], [(1,0,'accepted','OK',1,None)])
# I packet queued? impossible (I live) but I discarded then queued never
r = R([key(0,"I","discard"), dg(1,[pk("I",0,[PING])])])
check('T12 discard I', (r['packets'], r['keys']),
      ([(1,0,'dropped','KEYS_DISCARDED',1,None)], ('discarded','absent','absent','absent')))
# multiple traces independence
got,_ = run(doc(trace("a",[dg(1,[pk("I",0,[UNK])])]), trace("b",[dg(1,[pk("I",0,[PING])])])))
check('T13 traces independent', (got['results'][0]['connection']['state'], got['results'][1]['connection']['state']),
      ('closed','open'))
# Z and A pn space shared across queue
r = R([dg(1,[pk("Z",9,[PING])]), key(2,"A","install"), dg(3,[pk("A",9,[PING])])], early=True, buffer_packets=0)
check('T14 Z then A duplicate', r['packets'],
      [(0,0,'accepted','OK',1,None),(2,0,'duplicate','DUPLICATE',3,None)])
# queued packet then idle termination
r = R([dg(1,[pk("H",0,[PING])]), tick(100)], idle_ms=10, buffer_packets=4)
check('T15 queued dropped by idle', (r['packets'], r['conn']),
      ([(0,0,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',10,None)], ('idle','IDLE_TIMEOUT',10,(1,None,None),None,0)))
# CLOSE in a packet that also has an earlier error -> error wins
r = R([KA, A(0,[ST(1,0,"61"), CL(False,5)])])
check('T16 error before close', r['conn'], ('closed','STREAM_STATE_ERROR',1,(1,0,0),None,0))
# app close in Z
r = R([dg(1,[pk("Z",0,[CL(True,0)])])], early=True)
check('T17 app close Z code0', r['conn'], ('closed','PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE',1,(0,0,0),0,1))
